other_terms: Free freight included. Remaining 50 units unfulfilled; seller to raise with sales director for possible earlier ship or alternate stock, but no commitment made. Buyer to cover shortfall independently as needed.
notes: Closed at $47/unit, within ceiling of $49. Delivery at day 40 exceeds the 30-day target and will incur idle-line penalties of $800/day for 10 days (~$8,000) on the 150 units received on that schedule. Only 150 of 200 needed units secured; must source remaining 50 units elsewhere or absorb further delay/penalty on that portion. Seller was firm and consistent that day-40 ship date and quantity cap were fixed regardless of price increases; no written approval obtained for exceptions during this conversation. Recommend following up with seller post-director-consult and separately pursuing alternate supplier for the 50-unit gap and/or expedited partial delivery to mitigate penalty exposure.
